info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Human Resource Management Recruitment By Recruitment Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Update Recruitment Details API is designed to facilitate modifications to existing recruitment records within the banking human resource management system. By specifying the recruitment ID, stakeholders can update various attributes related to ongoing recruitment processes. This endpoint supports personnel in HR departments, staffing agencies, and recruiters who need to stay compliant with hiring practices and update candidate information dynamically. Use this API to ensure that recruitment records reflect the most current state of hiring efforts.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific recruitment resource identified by its unique ID. Utilize this operation to modify attributes or data associated with the recruitment process efficiently.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update specific fields of a recruitment process for the designated resource. It allows clients to send the necessary data to amend attributes associated with the resource identified by RES-100045.

200.description: The update was successful and the resource has been modified.
